summary: 34-year-old Lakewood woman injured her knee on the Royal Arch Trail jumping rock-to-rock descending after sunset; RMRG litter-carried her to the Enchanted Mesa/Mesa Trail intersection, then ranger vehicle to Chautauqua for transport to care (case #21-37)
notes: INSERT run974: BCSO news release Jan-3-2021, case #21-37. ~3.5-hour rescue; assisting: City of Boulder OSMP, RMRG.
